description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for managing WidgetsBundle entities in the Thingsboard platform. It includes endpoints for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting widget bundles, as well as listing bundles with filtering options. The class is annotated with Spring and custom annotations, and interacts with service layers and external resources.

classes.name: WidgetsBundleController
classes.description: REST controller for managing widget bundles, providing CRUD operations and listing with filters.

methods.name: getWidgetsBundleById
methods.description: Retrieves a widget bundle by its ID, optionally inlining images.

methods.name: saveWidgetsBundle
methods.description: Creates or updates a widget bundle based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: updateWidgetsBundleWidgetTypes
methods.description: Updates the list of widget types associated with a widget bundle.

methods.name: updateWidgetsBundleWidgetFqns
methods.description: Updates the widget bundle's widget list from widget type FQNs.

methods.name: deleteWidgetsBundle
methods.description: Deletes a widget bundle by its ID.

methods.name: getWidgetsBundles
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of widget bundles with filtering options.

methods.name: getWidgetsBundlesV1
methods.description: Returns all widget bundles visible to the current user (hidden endpoint).

methods.name: getAllWidgetsBundles
methods.description: Returns all widget bundles available for the current user.

methods.name: getWidgetsBundlesByIds
methods.description: Retrieves widget bundles by a set of UUIDs.

methods.name: getWidgetsBundlesList
methods.description: Retrieves widget bundles by IDs, with list format.
